name: array_length
title: array_length(x) -> number
description: **primitive**; returns the current length of array x, which is 1 plus the highest index that has been used so far in an array assignment on x. Here literal array expressions are counted too: The array [10, 20, 30] has a length of 3. Time: Θ(1), space: Θ(1)

name: is_array
title: is_array(x) -> boolean
description: **primitive**; returns true if x is an array, and false if it is not. Time: Θ(1), space: Θ(1)
